scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically from an explicit singleton extremizer, a global Chebyshev supporting-line inequality, contact evaluation, and a compactness perturbation argument. The bundled finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: The theorem classifies exactly which single added frequency leaves the singleton optimum unchanged, but it does not give a closed formula for \(\mathcal M_{m,n}\) in the strict regime and does not treat more than one added higher frequency.

title: Odd-multiple rigidity for one-frequency Carathéodory–Fejér augmentation
